originals.citation: Gantman, A., Kapp, S. K., Orenski, K., & Laugeson, E. A. (2012). Social skills training for young adults with high-functioning autism spectrum disorders: A randomized controlled pilot study. Journal of Autism and Developmental Disorders.

quote: The first and primary aim of the present study was to replicate the Gantman et al. (2012) findings, as pertains to PEERS®' effects on social skills knowledge, ASD symptoms, empathy, loneliness, and social contacts.
notes: Read the published JADD version (McVey et al. 2016) of this thesis. Laugeson et al. 2015 (@laugeson2015) is described as a within-site replication of the original, cited for comparison, not the target. List entry dated 2011 (online-first).
